all_tweets.title: Today, we delivered a major new product launch with the introduction of CPN Managed Payments.  As we
all_tweets.description:
Today, we delivered a major new product launch with the introduction of CPN Managed Payments.  As we continue to scale stablecoin payments, and build on the rapid growth we've already been seeing on CPN, we found a very strong need from banks, PSPs, fintechs and large tech firms for a solution that enabled them to operate fiat-to-fiat and fiat-stablecoin payment flows without needing to stand-up and operate their own wallets and blockchain infrastructure, or handle digital assets and stablecoins directory (minting, custody,etc) and similarly to stand-up the licensing and compliance requirements for using stablecoins and blockchains for payments activity.

Managed Payments enables an FI to join and operate on CPN, while Circle handles the rest, building on our decade-plus experience operating the world's most widely adopted, compliant and regulated infrastruture for digital currency payments.

CPN Managed Payments significantly expands Circle's CPN offering, and we believe will accelerate adoption by FIs around the world.

Details, including the full API set, included below.

https://t.co/cFo81Nkm6Z

"9 minutes to crack Bitcoin?" ⏱️ 

Google's new quantum whitepaper has the industry talking, but wha
all_tweets.description:
"9 minutes to crack Bitcoin?" ⏱️ 

Google's new quantum whitepaper has the industry talking, but what's the reality behind the headlines?

Here is what you need to know:

1️⃣ The "9 minutes" estimate relies on idealized assumptions (perfect error correction, microsecond gate operations).

2️⃣ Lower resource estimates do not equal immediate attack capability. Massive engineering challenges remain.

3️⃣ The real challenge? Cryptographic upgrades take years. 2030–2035 is the critical window to be ready, not the exact date of an attack.

The goal isn't just to adopt post-quantum algorithms, but to build systems capable of continuous cryptographic adaptation. 🛡️

Read the full technical breakdown by our Chief Scientist here: https://t.co/Sm2FWBlyyd

#QuantumComputing #Bitcoin #BlockchainSecurity #Cryptography

The CLARITY
all_tweets.description:
🇺🇸The Clarity Act is stuck as the fight over stablecoin yield reaches the final stage.

The CLARITY Act passed the House (294–134) with strong bipartisan backing, with support from Donald Trump. Cynthia Lummis said stablecoin negotiations are “99% done.”

But the situation has now shifted.

The bill is stuck in a four-way deadlock, with banks, the Senate, the crypto industry, and critics each holding enough leverage to slow or block progress.

The main friction point is stablecoin yield. Banks are pushing back due to risks of deposit outflows, while the industry wants to keep yield opportunities open.

Right now, it’s all about closing the gaps between these sides.

🔹Power is split across all sides
🔹Final terms are still being shaped
🔹Consensus is not fully locked yet

What happens next depends on how this deadlock gets resolved. That will decide how fast the bill moves forward.

@SenLummis

all_tweets.title: SHRED uses Fireblocks, an institutional-grade digital asset custody platform trusted by leading exch
all_tweets.description:
SHRED uses Fireblocks, an institutional-grade digital asset custody platform trusted by leading exchanges and funds, to securely hold and move user assets.

All funds are stored in Fireblocks Vault accounts protected by multi-party computation (MPC), eliminating single private-key risk by distributing signing authority across multiple parties.

Every transaction passes through a strict rule engine and allow-listed destinations, meaning assets can only move to pre-approved wallets, exchanges, or contracts.

Beyond Fireblocks’ native safeguards, SHRED adds an independent guardian layer that performs automated cross-checks through multiple systems before any transfer is finalized, creating an extra institutional-grade validation step.

For users, none of this adds friction. When you deposit into SHRED, your funds are custodied through Fireblocks and governed by multiple layers of automated, policy-based security before a single coin moves.

all_tweets.title: Institutional Adoption Accelerates as Anchorage Integrates TRON into Regulated Crypto Infrastructure
all_tweets.description:
Institutional Adoption Accelerates as Anchorage Integrates TRON into Regulated Crypto Infrastructure

Institutional participation continues to shape the evolution of blockchain adoption, and the latest integration between Anchorage Digital and TRON represents another major step toward bridging traditional finance with decentralized networks.

As the first federally chartered crypto bank in the United States, Anchorage provides compliant digital asset custody solutions trusted by institutions seeking secure and regulated exposure to blockchain ecosystems.

With TRON now supported on Anchorage’s platform, institutional clients gain the ability to securely custody TRX within a regulatory framework designed to meet strict financial compliance standards.

This development strengthens confidence among professional investors, asset managers, and enterprises looking to access blockchain-based financial infrastructure while maintaining operational transparency and risk management controls.

Beyond custody, the next phase of integration is expected to expand support for TRC20 assets as well as native TRX staking capabilities.

These additional features will enable institutions not only to hold TRX securely, but also to actively participate in network validation mechanisms, contributing to the decentralization and security of the TRON blockchain.

By enabling staking participation, institutions can engage more deeply with the network while potentially benefiting from blockchain-based incentive structures aligned with long-term ecosystem growth.

The integration demonstrates how compliant infrastructure providers are increasingly supporting high-performance networks capable of handling large-scale stablecoin settlement, DeFi applications, and global payment flows.

TRON’s strong presence in stablecoin activity and decentralized finance continues to position it as a key settlement layer for digital asset transactions worldwide.

Institutional-grade custody solutions such as Anchorage play an important role in enabling broader adoption by reducing barriers related to security, governance, and regulatory clarity.

As more compliant financial institutions integrate TRON infrastructure, the ecosystem becomes more accessible to global capital markets seeking efficient blockchain-based financial rails.

The collaboration reflects a broader trend in which digital asset innovation is increasingly supported by trusted financial institutions, reinforcing confidence in the long-term development of decentralized economic systems.

Learn more: https://t.co/8Go71JxRUd

Anchorage Digital has added support for TRON DAO, becoming the first federally chartered U.S. firm to bring TRON within a regulated institutional framework.

•Expanded access for regulated entities

恭喜USD1 的 DeFi 版图继续起飞！🚀
第一个「USD1 Morpho 金库」已在 Monad 网络正式上线！💰

这是 WLFI 团队为 USD1 打造的又一重磅使用场景，标志着它从单纯的“稳定币”，正式升级为“生息赚钱机器”。

以前拿着 USD1，最多就是存着、转账、保值。

现在不一样了——接入 Morpho 协议后，你把 USD1 存进这个专属金库，资金会自动借给别人赚利息。借款人用 ETH、BTC 等加密资产做超额抵押，支付的利息就是你的收益。

金库由 Steakhouse curation 负责管理，智能调控借贷、抵押率和利率，你基本不用操心，直接躺赚。

根据 Morpho 实时数据，目前净年化收益约 9%-13%（随市场波动）。

同时零管理费、零绩效费，收益几乎全部归存款人。

当前总存款已突破 200 万美元级别，热度拉满，不少聪明钱已经进场试水。

为什么说这是 USD1 的“DeFi 大扩张”？💰🚀

这是 USD1 的首个 Morpho 金库，首次真正深度进入 DeFi 借贷市场；

同时也是 USD1 在高性能新链 Monad 上的首次 DeFi 落地。

Monad 速度快、手续费低，非常适合大规模 DeFi 玩法。

USD1 由 BitGo 托管，100% 锚定美元 + 短期美债，审计透明，机构级安全。

现在不只保值，还能自动生息，相当于把“存银行”升级成“去中心化高息理财”。

WLFI 团队动作不断，后续大概率还会走多链、多协议扩展，让 USD1 的流动性更强、场景更丰富。

USD1 正在从“数字美元”进化成“会赚钱的数字美元”。

想让稳定币闲钱动起来的富贵兄弟💰，可以去 Monad 上通过 LayerZero 桥接 USD1🌉，再存进 Morpho 金库🏦躺赚！✨

policy.title: Today, we delivered a major new product launch with the introduction of CPN Managed Payments.  As we
policy.description:
Today, we delivered a major new product launch with the introduction of CPN Managed Payments.  As we continue to scale stablecoin payments, and build on the rapid growth we've already been seeing on CPN, we found a very strong need from banks, PSPs, fintechs and large tech firms for a solution that enabled them to operate fiat-to-fiat and fiat-stablecoin payment flows without needing to stand-up and operate their own wallets and blockchain infrastructure, or handle digital assets and stablecoins directory (minting, custody,etc) and similarly to stand-up the licensing and compliance requirements for using stablecoins and blockchains for payments activity.

Managed Payments enables an FI to join and operate on CPN, while Circle handles the rest, building on our decade-plus experience operating the world's most widely adopted, compliant and regulated infrastruture for digital currency payments.

CPN Managed Payments significantly expands Circle's CPN offering, and we believe will accelerate adoption by FIs around the world.

Details, including the full API set, included below.

policy.title:
🇺🇸The Clarity Act is stuck as the fight over stablecoin yield reaches the final stage.

The CLARITY
policy.description:
🇺🇸The Clarity Act is stuck as the fight over stablecoin yield reaches the final stage.

The CLARITY Act passed the House (294–134) with strong bipartisan backing, with support from Donald Trump. Cynthia Lummis said stablecoin negotiations are “99% done.”

But the situation has now shifted.

The bill is stuck in a four-way deadlock, with banks, the Senate, the crypto industry, and critics each holding enough leverage to slow or block progress.

The main friction point is stablecoin yield. Banks are pushing back due to risks of deposit outflows, while the industry wants to keep yield opportunities open.

Right now, it’s all about closing the gaps between these sides.

🔹Power is split across all sides
🔹Final terms are still being shaped
🔹Consensus is not fully locked yet

What happens next depends on how this deadlock gets resolved. That will decide how fast the bill moves forward.

@SenLummis

"9 minutes to crack Bitcoin?" ⏱️ 

Google's new quantum whitepaper has the industry talking, but wha
company.description:
"9 minutes to crack Bitcoin?" ⏱️ 

Google's new quantum whitepaper has the industry talking, but what's the reality behind the headlines?

Here is what you need to know:

1️⃣ The "9 minutes" estimate relies on idealized assumptions (perfect error correction, microsecond gate operations).

2️⃣ Lower resource estimates do not equal immediate attack capability. Massive engineering challenges remain.

3️⃣ The real challenge? Cryptographic upgrades take years. 2030–2035 is the critical window to be ready, not the exact date of an attack.

The goal isn't just to adopt post-quantum algorithms, but to build systems capable of continuous cryptographic adaptation. 🛡️

Read the full technical breakdown by our Chief Scientist here: https://t.co/Sm2FWBlyyd

#QuantumComputing #Bitcoin #BlockchainSecurity #Cryptography

company.title: SHRED uses Fireblocks, an institutional-grade digital asset custody platform trusted by leading exch
company.description:
SHRED uses Fireblocks, an institutional-grade digital asset custody platform trusted by leading exchanges and funds, to securely hold and move user assets.

All funds are stored in Fireblocks Vault accounts protected by multi-party computation (MPC), eliminating single private-key risk by distributing signing authority across multiple parties.

Every transaction passes through a strict rule engine and allow-listed destinations, meaning assets can only move to pre-approved wallets, exchanges, or contracts.

Beyond Fireblocks’ native safeguards, SHRED adds an independent guardian layer that performs automated cross-checks through multiple systems before any transfer is finalized, creating an extra institutional-grade validation step.

For users, none of this adds friction. When you deposit into SHRED, your funds are custodied through Fireblocks and governed by multiple layers of automated, policy-based security before a single coin moves.

company.title: Institutional Adoption Accelerates as Anchorage Integrates TRON into Regulated Crypto Infrastructure
company.description:
Institutional Adoption Accelerates as Anchorage Integrates TRON into Regulated Crypto Infrastructure

Institutional participation continues to shape the evolution of blockchain adoption, and the latest integration between Anchorage Digital and TRON represents another major step toward bridging traditional finance with decentralized networks.

As the first federally chartered crypto bank in the United States, Anchorage provides compliant digital asset custody solutions trusted by institutions seeking secure and regulated exposure to blockchain ecosystems.

With TRON now supported on Anchorage’s platform, institutional clients gain the ability to securely custody TRX within a regulatory framework designed to meet strict financial compliance standards.

This development strengthens confidence among professional investors, asset managers, and enterprises looking to access blockchain-based financial infrastructure while maintaining operational transparency and risk management controls.

Beyond custody, the next phase of integration is expected to expand support for TRC20 assets as well as native TRX staking capabilities.

These additional features will enable institutions not only to hold TRX securely, but also to actively participate in network validation mechanisms, contributing to the decentralization and security of the TRON blockchain.

By enabling staking participation, institutions can engage more deeply with the network while potentially benefiting from blockchain-based incentive structures aligned with long-term ecosystem growth.

The integration demonstrates how compliant infrastructure providers are increasingly supporting high-performance networks capable of handling large-scale stablecoin settlement, DeFi applications, and global payment flows.

TRON’s strong presence in stablecoin activity and decentralized finance continues to position it as a key settlement layer for digital asset transactions worldwide.

Institutional-grade custody solutions such as Anchorage play an important role in enabling broader adoption by reducing barriers related to security, governance, and regulatory clarity.

As more compliant financial institutions integrate TRON infrastructure, the ecosystem becomes more accessible to global capital markets seeking efficient blockchain-based financial rails.

The collaboration reflects a broader trend in which digital asset innovation is increasingly supported by trusted financial institutions, reinforcing confidence in the long-term development of decentralized economic systems.

Learn more: https://t.co/8Go71JxRUd

The bridge between blockchain and regulated financial systems continues to strengthen.

Anchorage Digital has added support for TRON DAO, becoming the first federally chartered U.S. firm to bring TRON within a regulated institutional framework.

This development represents more than a technical integration — it signals a meaningful shift in how blockchain networks are being recognized within traditional financial systems.

By entering the U.S. regulatory perimeter through Anchorage Digital, TRON gains:
•Increased credibility among institutional players
•Expanded access for regulated entities
•A clearer pathway for compliant adoption and integration

For institutions, regulatory clarity is often the deciding factor between interest and participation. With this move, TRON becomes more accessible to firms that require strict compliance standards while still seeking exposure to blockchain infrastructure and digital assets.

Anchorage Digital’s role as a federally chartered crypto bank places it at the intersection of innovation and regulation - making this integration particularly significant in the broader context of Web3 adoption.

It reflects a growing trend where blockchain networks are no longer operating outside the system, but are increasingly being integrated into regulated financial environments.

For TRON, this marks another step toward bridging decentralized infrastructure with institutional-grade access - aligning with a future where blockchain is not just an alternative system, but part of the global financial framework.

As the industry continues to evolve, milestones like this highlight a clear direction:

Adoption at scale will be driven not just by technology, but by trust, compliance, and accessibility.

#TRONEcoStar @justinsuntron

恭喜USD1 的 DeFi 版图继续起飞！🚀
第一个「USD1 Morpho 金库」已在 Monad 网络正式上线！💰

这是 WLFI 团队为 USD1 打造的又一重磅使用场景，标志着它从单纯的“稳定币”，正式升级为“生息赚钱机器”。

以前拿着 USD1，最多就是存着、转账、保值。

现在不一样了——接入 Morpho 协议后，你把 USD1 存进这个专属金库，资金会自动借给别人赚利息。借款人用 ETH、BTC 等加密资产做超额抵押，支付的利息就是你的收益。

金库由 Steakhouse curation 负责管理，智能调控借贷、抵押率和利率，你基本不用操心，直接躺赚。

根据 Morpho 实时数据，目前净年化收益约 9%-13%（随市场波动）。

同时零管理费、零绩效费，收益几乎全部归存款人。

当前总存款已突破 200 万美元级别，热度拉满，不少聪明钱已经进场试水。

为什么说这是 USD1 的“DeFi 大扩张”？💰🚀

这是 USD1 的首个 Morpho 金库，首次真正深度进入 DeFi 借贷市场；

同时也是 USD1 在高性能新链 Monad 上的首次 DeFi 落地。

Monad 速度快、手续费低，非常适合大规模 DeFi 玩法。

USD1 由 BitGo 托管，100% 锚定美元 + 短期美债，审计透明，机构级安全。

现在不只保值，还能自动生息，相当于把“存银行”升级成“去中心化高息理财”。

WLFI 团队动作不断，后续大概率还会走多链、多协议扩展，让 USD1 的流动性更强、场景更丰富。

USD1 正在从“数字美元”进化成“会赚钱的数字美元”。

想让稳定币闲钱动起来的富贵兄弟💰，可以去 Monad 上通过 LayerZero 桥接 USD1🌉，再存进 Morpho 金库🏦躺赚！✨
